rules.duplicate_group: retain every locator without positional pairing
rules.empty_projection: native descriptors retained separately; never matching evidence
rules.inference_limit: lossy equality does not establish full body, glyph, word or region identity
rules.modern_selection: IT2a present only; no inferred page aliases
rules.order_and_bag: exact nonempty strings compared before digest serialization
rules.projection: accepted source-specific lowercase a-z body projection
